newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Intel EPS estimates hiked.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Intel EPS estimates hiked.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Co analyst Dan Niles raised his estimate of Intel Corp's earnings for the fourth quarter to $1.93 a share from $1.73 a share previously, his assistant said.
Niles also raised his estimate of Intel's fiscal 1997 earnings to $8.10 a share from $7.25 a share previously.
"Dan continues to see improving conditions in the semiconductor market," the assistant said, speaking for Niles in a telephone call.
In last year's fourth quarter Intel earned $0.98 a share.
Niles' revised 1996 fourth quarter estimate brings his full year 1996 estimate to $5.60 a share, up from $5.40 previously.
